analyst.summary: M&M is compounding volumes and share on both engines of its business -- record 27.3% SUV revenue share (+570bps YoY) and a record 45.2% FES tractor share in Q1 FY27 -- with margin expanding alongside growth (PBT margin ~10.9%->12.6% YoY) and genuine EV demand traction (BE 6/XEV 9e waitlists out to six months). The quant model's weak 31st-percentile Quality score is mostly a structural artifact of consolidating a large captive NBFC (Mahindra Finance) and several capital-intensive early-stage bets against pure-play peers that don't carry the same balance-sheet structure -- segment ROCE (Auto ~42%, Farm ~47%, FY24) is elite versus our 12.75% consolidated read -- though M&M's own history of low-return adjacent diversification means the underlying capital-discipline question isn't fully resolved either. The stock is down 18.8% off its 52-week high and 15.6% over six months, roughly twice the Nifty Auto index's own pullback, reading as post-rally multiple normalization plus a guidance-deceleration scare rather than a fundamental break. Call: Hold.
